_meta.note: 一個故事一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

First Wicker's Spark#001.src: It's a muddied page detailing how to make a wicker man. It must have flown in from down below.
First Wicker's Spark#001.dst: 這是一張沾滿泥巴的紙，詳細寫著柳枝人的做法。肯定是從下面飛上來的。

First Wicker's Spark#002.src: To form such a wicker man, first one must show its purpose clearly. Choose a platform, and demarcate its corners with rock.
First Wicker's Spark#002.dst: 要造這樣的柳枝人，首先必須明確表現其用途。選一座平台，{c2}用岩石標出四角{/}。

First Wicker's Spark#003.src: Afterwards, as per usual, a scaffold is erected upon a bed of hay, around which the wicker man is built.
First Wicker's Spark#003.dst: 接著一如往常，{c2}在一層乾草上搭起鷹架{/}，再圍著鷹架{c2}造出柳枝人{/}。
First Wicker's Spark#003.note: {c2}a scaffold is erected upon a bed of hay{/}, {c2}the wicker man is built{/}

First Wicker's Spark#004.src: Objects tied to what one wishes to forget are placed within the head. Then, as the wicker man burns, the memories scatter with the smoke...
First Wicker's Spark#004.dst: 與想遺忘之事相連的物品要放進頭部。之後，隨著柳枝人燃燒，記憶便隨煙飄散……

First Wicker's Spark#005.src: It's instructions for making a wicker man. Re-read them?
First Wicker's Spark#005.dst: 這是柳枝人的製作說明。要再讀一次嗎？

First Wicker's Spark#006.src: ...while the most known type of wicker man is that made to punish wrongdoers and spies, there is another type - one to forget memories.
First Wicker's Spark#006.dst: ……最為人知的柳枝人是用來懲罰惡徒與間諜的，但還有另一種——用來忘卻記憶。

First Wicker's Spark#007.src: There's plenty of lumber in the crate. You could probably construct a scaffold and still have some wood to spare.
First Wicker's Spark#007.dst: 木箱裡有不少木材。搭好鷹架大概還有剩。

First Wicker's Spark#008.src: It would be best to place a bed of hay if you're going to build the scaffold, though.
First Wicker's Spark#008.dst: 不過要搭鷹架的話，最好先鋪上{c2}一層乾草{/}。

First Wicker's Spark#009.src: You. You you look strange. Not like the the ones to patrol here. And with with a strange weapon.
First Wicker's Spark#009.dst: 你。你你看起來怪怪的。跟跟這裡巡邏的那些人不一樣。還拿著拿著奇怪的武器。
First Wicker's Spark#009.speaker: Fort Hegea Archer

First Wicker's Spark#010.src: Maybe you can help help me. I am forced to stay here here and practice. Practice until I can speak speak and shoot correctly.
First Wicker's Spark#010.dst: 也許你能幫我幫我。我被迫留在這裡這裡練習。練習到我能正確說話說話、正確射箭為止。
First Wicker's Spark#010.speaker: Fort Hegea Archer

First Wicker's Spark#011.src: But the rock rock in the way is annoying. It blocks blocks my path to shoot! ! So.
First Wicker's Spark#011.dst: 但擋路的岩石岩石很煩。它擋住擋住我射箭的路！！所以。
First Wicker's Spark#011.speaker: Fort Hegea Archer

First Wicker's Spark#012.src: Maybe you can can help, if you are staying here too? You could go blow it it up, or something. I know know there are explosives somewhere in the camp.
First Wicker's Spark#012.dst: 你也留在這裡的話，也許能能幫忙？你可以去把它把它炸掉什麼的。我知道知道營地某處有炸藥。
First Wicker's Spark#012.speaker: Fort Hegea Archer

First Wicker's Spark#013.src: You already have have some TNT, right? You could go blow the rock rock up, with it.
First Wicker's Spark#013.dst: 你已經有有 TNT 了，對吧？你可以拿它去把岩石岩石炸掉。
First Wicker's Spark#013.speaker: Fort Hegea Archer

First Wicker's Spark#014.src: I can finally practice practice my archery properly now. I think think I will get started.
First Wicker's Spark#014.dst: 我終於能好好練習練習射箭了。我想我想我要開始了。
First Wicker's Spark#014.speaker: Fort Hegea Archer

First Wicker's Spark#015.src: At least least, as soon as I am done practicing my speaking. For today today, there is still...
First Wicker's Spark#015.dst: 至少至少，等我練完說話就開始。今天今天還有……
First Wicker's Spark#015.speaker: Fort Hegea Archer

First Wicker's Spark#016.src: As the brooch comes into view, the memories seeped into it start to effloresce...
First Wicker's Spark#016.dst: 胸針映入眼簾，滲入其中的記憶開始綻放……

First Wicker's Spark#017.src: ...finally found you. You have a way of making yourself scarce, you know that?
First Wicker's Spark#017.dst: ……總算找到你了。你這人真會搞失蹤，知道嗎？
First Wicker's Spark#017.speaker: Clan Member

First Wicker's Spark#018.src: Ah. Hello, Kawri. Is something the matter for you to seek me out?
First Wicker's Spark#018.dst: 啊。你好，Kawri。特地來找我，是出了什麼事嗎？
First Wicker's Spark#018.speaker: Azael

First Wicker's Spark#019.src: Orders from the clan. We're to meet at the Pyre tonight. There's apparently an important matter to discuss.
First Wicker's Spark#019.dst: 氏族的命令。今晚到焚台集合。聽說有要事商議。
First Wicker's Spark#019.speaker: Kawri

First Wicker's Spark#020.src: The Pyre... how come? If the meeting is to take place there, surely the other clans will also be attending?
First Wicker's Spark#020.dst: 焚台……為什麼？若在那裡集會，其他氏族想必也會出席吧？
First Wicker's Spark#020.speaker: Azael

First Wicker's Spark#021.src: I wasn't filled in on the details. Just told to try and chase after some of the more fickle members of our clan for form's sake.
First Wicker's Spark#021.dst: 細節我也不清楚。只是叫我做做樣子，去追幾個氏族裡比較難捉摸的人。
First Wicker's Spark#021.speaker: Kawri

First Wicker's Spark#022.src: So you don't even know why. Hm. And are we convening at the same time as usual?
First Wicker's Spark#022.dst: 所以你連原因都不知道。嗯。時間還是跟平常一樣嗎？
First Wicker's Spark#022.speaker: Azael

First Wicker's Spark#023.src: Apparently, we'll be starting about a quarter of an hour later. Another clan has requested extra time for preparations.
First Wicker's Spark#023.dst: 聽說會晚大約一刻鐘開始。有別的氏族要求多點時間準備。
First Wicker's Spark#023.speaker: Kawri

First Wicker's Spark#024.src: I still have a few others to track down, so I can't stay long. I take it I can confirm your attendance?
First Wicker's Spark#024.dst: 我還有幾個人要找，不能久留。我可以回報說你會到吧？
First Wicker's Spark#024.speaker: Kawri

First Wicker's Spark#025.src: If it's a meeting by the Pyre, then who am I to say no? I'll be seeing you all there tonight.
First Wicker's Spark#025.dst: 既然是焚台旁的集會，我哪有拒絕的道理？今晚就在那裡和大家見面。
First Wicker's Spark#025.speaker: Azael

First Wicker's Spark#026.src: As the pendant glimmers in the light, the memories seeped into it start to effloresce...
First Wicker's Spark#026.dst: 墜飾在光中閃爍，滲入其中的記憶開始綻放……

First Wicker's Spark#027.src: Gikyo! Great to see ya! Are you up to hear some gossip? This one's got some bark to it, too...
First Wicker's Spark#027.dst: Gikyo！真高興見到你！想聽點八卦嗎？這條可夠嗆喔……
First Wicker's Spark#027.speaker: Clan Member

First Wicker's Spark#028.src: Am I? You know my answer, so why ask? Go on, go on, it's been so boring today! Spill the beans!
First Wicker's Spark#028.dst: 還用問？你明知道我的答案，幹嘛問？快說快說，今天無聊死了！給我從實招來！
First Wicker's Spark#028.speaker: Gikyo

First Wicker's Spark#029.src: Alright, alright. This one's from a clan member who knows another over in the Staghorn clan. So, get this...
First Wicker's Spark#029.dst: 好啦好啦。這條來自一位族人，他認識鹿角氏族的人。聽好囉……
First Wicker's Spark#029.speaker: Clan Member

First Wicker's Spark#030.src: Word on the wind there's that they saw one of their members, Ophir, doing something super odd.
First Wicker's Spark#030.dst: 那邊的風聲說，有人看到他們的成員 Ophir 在做超級奇怪的事。
First Wicker's Spark#030.speaker: Clan Member

First Wicker's Spark#040.src: Wait, THAT Ophir? They're such a snooze, though! What, were they finally up for a card game for once?
First Wicker's Spark#040.dst: 等等，「那個」Ophir？那傢伙明明悶得要命！怎樣，他終於肯打一次牌了？
First Wicker's Spark#040.speaker: Gikyo

First Wicker's Spark#041.src: No, no, don't misunderstand. This was odd even by our standards! So, the clan member saw some weird smoke, and over in it...
First Wicker's Spark#041.dst: 不不，別誤會。這事就算照我們的標準也夠怪！那名族人看見一團怪煙，然後煙裡面……
First Wicker's Spark#041.speaker: Clan Member

First Wicker's Spark#042.src: Bam! Ophir, spinning and growing from the ground! And, though I can't be so sure, apparently they had some goop on their hand that they shook off, too!
First Wicker's Spark#042.dst: 砰！Ophir 一邊旋轉一邊從地上長出來！而且，這我不敢打包票，聽說他手上還沾著黏糊糊的東西，被他甩掉了！
First Wicker's Spark#042.speaker: Clan Member

First Wicker's Spark#043.src: Whuh? Hey now, you sure you heard that right? Maybe they just slipped at a mud pit while out patrolling?
First Wicker's Spark#043.dst: 咦？喂喂，你確定沒聽錯？說不定他只是巡邏時在泥坑滑了一跤？
First Wicker's Spark#043.speaker: Gikyo

First Wicker's Spark#044.src: Yeah, you'd think something like that, right? But apparently some OTHER Stag won't budge on it being true!
First Wicker's Spark#044.dst: 對啊，一般都會這麼想吧？可是聽說「另一個」鹿角族人咬定這是真的！
First Wicker's Spark#044.speaker: Clan Member

First Wicker's Spark#045.src: ...hah. That really is one hell of a rumor! If you keep finding ones this spicy, I won't be able to one-up you!
First Wicker's Spark#045.dst: ……哈。這傳聞也太勁爆了！你再挖到這麼辣的料，我可就壓不過你了！
First Wicker's Spark#045.speaker: Gikyo

First Wicker's Spark#046.src: You got that right! Well, I'll have to be off. See you later! You'd better have something to share then!
First Wicker's Spark#046.dst: 那還用說！好啦，我得走了。回頭見！到時候你最好也有料可爆！
First Wicker's Spark#046.speaker: Clan Member

First Wicker's Spark#047.src: ...Ophir. That Ophir. Of the ones here, to think it'd be them?
First Wicker's Spark#047.dst: ……Ophir。那個 Ophir。這裡這些人當中，沒想到居然是他？
First Wicker's Spark#047.speaker: Gikyo

First Wicker's Spark#048.src: Do you want to construct the scaffold?

First Wicker's Spark#049.src: The scaffold is built! But the lumber from the crate won't be enough to build the wicker. There might be more in the camp.
First Wicker's Spark#049.dst: 鷹架搭好了！但木箱裡的木材不夠造柳枝人。{c2}營地裡{/}也許還有。

First Wicker's Spark#050.src: It's constructed! Now for the finishing touches...
First Wicker's Spark#050.dst: 造好了！接下來是最後的修飾……

First Wicker's Spark#051.src: The wicker is complete! Now, just to find something to light it. There should be some candles around that you could use.
First Wicker's Spark#051.dst: 柳枝人完成了！現在只要找東西點火。附近應該有能用的{c2}蠟燭{/}。

First Wicker's Spark#052.src: There should be some candles around that you could use to light the wicker.
First Wicker's Spark#052.dst: 附近應該有能用來點燃柳枝人的{c2}蠟燭{/}。

First Wicker's Spark#053.src: As you lift the candle, a flicker of memories begins to effloresce...
First Wicker's Spark#053.dst: 你舉起蠟燭，一縷閃動的記憶開始綻放……

First Wicker's Spark#054.src: Is that Azael I see? What, why's this sly old fox showing up out in the open tonight?
First Wicker's Spark#054.dst: 我沒看錯吧，那是 Azael？怎麼，這隻狡猾的老狐狸今晚竟然跑到明處來了？
First Wicker's Spark#054.speaker: Gikyo

First Wicker's Spark#055.src: Gikyo. It's good to see you too. Are you also headed to-
First Wicker's Spark#055.dst: Gikyo。我也很高興見到你。你也正要去——
First Wicker's Spark#055.speaker: Azael

First Wicker's Spark#056.src: Listen, listen, I got told some reeeal interesting gossip today, and that's why you'll get to hear it too!
First Wicker's Spark#056.dst: 聽我說聽我說，我今天聽到一條超——有趣的八卦，所以你也有耳福了！
First Wicker's Spark#056.speaker: Gikyo

First Wicker's Spark#057.src: Can we not discuss as we walk? Or is this something meant to be kept secret?
First Wicker's Spark#057.dst: 不能邊走邊說嗎？還是這件事得保密？
First Wicker's Spark#057.speaker: Azael

First Wicker's Spark#058.src: Ha! What better way to talk than idly? So, so, get this. It's about Ophir. And from what I've heard... they slipped up.
First Wicker's Spark#058.dst: 哈！還有什麼比閒聊更好的？好，好，聽著。是 Ophir 的事。我聽說……他失手了。
First Wicker's Spark#058.speaker: Gikyo

First Wicker's Spark#059.src: Oh? In what way did they slip up? I believed them to be the most diligent of our newest assignees...
First Wicker's Spark#059.dst: 哦？他怎麼個失手法？我還以為他是新派來的人當中最勤勉的……
First Wicker's Spark#059.speaker: Azael

First Wicker's Spark#060.src: ...okay. You may want to say this can't be true. But. At least one clan member saw them in the middle of changing. Thought you ought to know.
First Wicker's Spark#060.dst: ……好吧。你大概會說這不可能。但是。至少有一名氏族成員看到他正在變形。我想你該知道一下。
First Wicker's Spark#060.speaker: Gikyo

First Wicker's Spark#061.src: Ah. Wait, but then... that'd make anyone as paranoid as a clan member... Oh. Oh no.
First Wicker's Spark#061.dst: 啊。等等，可是那樣的話……任誰都會跟氏族的人一樣疑神疑鬼……哦。不好了。
First Wicker's Spark#061.speaker: Azael

First Wicker's Spark#062.src: Gikyo, are you aware that there's a meeting at the Pyre tonight?
First Wicker's Spark#062.dst: Gikyo，你知道今晚焚台有集會嗎？
First Wicker's Spark#062.speaker: Azael

First Wicker's Spark#063.src: What? Must have slipped my ears! Or my mind! But this week's been so uneventful, so why now? Unless-
First Wicker's Spark#063.dst: 什麼？一定是我沒聽到！或是忘了！可是這週風平浪靜的，怎麼偏偏現在？除非——
First Wicker's Spark#063.speaker: Gikyo

First Wicker's Spark#064.src: ... you got it too. There's only one reason that a meeting by the Pyre would be called - someone is being made a statement.
First Wicker's Spark#064.dst: ……你也想到了。焚台的集會只會為一個原因召開——有人要被拿來殺雞儆猴。
First Wicker's Spark#064.speaker: Azael

First Wicker's Spark#065.src: What time is it? When's the meeting? Can we even make it before then to try and save Ophir?
First Wicker's Spark#065.dst: 現在幾點？集會什麼時候？我們趕得及在那之前去救 Ophir 嗎？
First Wicker's Spark#065.speaker: Gikyo

First Wicker's Spark#066.src: There's still- oh no. It's starting any time. Let's go, NOW! If we run, maybe we can still somehow smuggle them out!
First Wicker's Spark#066.dst: 還有——糟了。隨時都要開始了。走，馬上走！用跑的，說不定還能把他偷偷帶走！
First Wicker's Spark#066.speaker: Azael

First Wicker's Spark#067.src: As the wicker starts to burn, the memories burning away coalesce within you!
First Wicker's Spark#067.dst: 柳枝人開始燃燒，燒去的記憶在你體內匯聚！

First Wicker's Spark#068.src: Well, given the severity of the crime, letting you indulge seems most fitting. You're quite the ardent orator, after all. After you!
First Wicker's Spark#068.dst: 好吧，這罪行如此嚴重，由你盡情發揮再合適不過。畢竟你是那麼熱切的演說家。請吧！
First Wicker's Spark#068.speaker: Clan Member

First Wicker's Spark#069.src: TONIGHT, WE MEET BEYOND THE MIST
First Wicker's Spark#069.speaker: Orator Caetal

First Wicker's Spark#070.src: TO PURGE A TRAITOR FROM OUR MIDST;
First Wicker's Spark#070.speaker: Clan Members

First Wicker's Spark#071.src: NO LONGER WILL THIS BEAST CONSPIRE
First Wicker's Spark#071.speaker: Clan Members

First Wicker's Spark#073.src: SO FAN THE FLAMES, AND WATCH IT SQUIRM-
First Wicker's Spark#073.speaker: Clan Members

First Wicker's Spark#074.src: 'TIL NOTHING MORE IS LEFT TO BURN!
First Wicker's Spark#074.speaker: Clan Members

First Wicker's Spark#078.src: ...nothing. Nary a trace. Only ashes remain... We were too late.
First Wicker's Spark#078.dst: ……什麼都沒有。連一絲痕跡也沒留下。只剩灰燼……我們來得太遲了。
First Wicker's Spark#078.speaker: Azael

First Wicker's Spark#079.src: Damn it all! Damn the clans, damn these woods, and this blasted pyre! Jumping straight to putting them in a wicker man?!
First Wicker's Spark#079.dst: 可惡透頂！該死的氏族、該死的森林，還有這鬼焚台！一上來就把他塞進柳枝人？！
First Wicker's Spark#079.speaker: Gikyo

First Wicker's Spark#080.src: You should have known this would happen the moment you heard Ophir's name. To a clan, few actions are worse than espionage.
First Wicker's Spark#080.dst: 你一聽到 Ophir 的名字，就該知道會這樣。對氏族來說，比間諜行為更惡劣的事沒幾件。
First Wicker's Spark#080.speaker: Azael

First Wicker's Spark#081.src: So what? It's not... as if... they could have KNOWN! It's not normal! Again, what kind of person would even SUGGEST a ritual burning for ANY situation?
First Wicker's Spark#081.dst: 那又怎樣？又不是……好像……他能「料到」！這根本不正常！再說一次，到底什麼人會在「任何」情況下「提議」用儀式燒人？
First Wicker's Spark#081.speaker: Gikyo

First Wicker's Spark#082.src: "Look at me, I'm Ophir! There's a tiny bit of smoke around me!", and what, the clans just love the visual? They love it so much Ophir gets reduced to nothing BUT smoke?
First Wicker's Spark#082.dst: 「看我，我是 Ophir！我身邊有一點點煙！」然後呢，氏族就愛上這畫面了？愛到要把 Ophir 燒得「只剩」煙？
First Wicker's Spark#082.speaker: Gikyo

First Wicker's Spark#083.src: And again, this meeting was inevitable the moment they saw Ophir. As long as those like us are forced into these roles, this will be our punishment for failing to perform them.
First Wicker's Spark#083.dst: 而且我再說一次，他們看到 Ophir 的那一刻，這場集會就避免不了。只要我們這種人還被迫扮演這些角色，演不好的懲罰就是這樣。
First Wicker's Spark#083.speaker: Azael

First Wicker's Spark#084.src: You. You... ha! Hahahaha! You really think so? What, are the clans imprinting on you THAT much? You'd call this justified?
First Wicker's Spark#084.dst: 你。你……哈！哈哈哈哈！你真這麼想？怎樣，氏族的印記在你身上烙得「這麼」深？你說這很正當？
First Wicker's Spark#084.speaker: Gikyo

First Wicker's Spark#085.src: What a hoot! I daresay they only justify revenge against THEM! We'll see how the clan heads like it, grilled to a smoky finish...
First Wicker's Spark#085.dst: 真是笑死我了！要我說，這只證明向「他們」復仇才正當！就看氏族長們喜不喜歡被烤到煙燻入味……
First Wicker's Spark#085.speaker: Gikyo

First Wicker's Spark#086.src: When did I justify it? Yet again, the root of the problem is what WE are forced to do. Our appearance and existence defined by orders from the top...
First Wicker's Spark#086.dst: 我何時說過這正當？再說一次，問題的根源在於「我們」被迫做的事。我們的樣貌與存在，全由上頭的命令決定……
First Wicker's Spark#086.speaker: Azael

First Wicker's Spark#087.src: ...discarded at will, unable to even say WHO we are, lest our existence be scattered upon-
First Wicker's Spark#087.dst: ……隨意丟棄，連自己是「誰」都說不得，唯恐我們的存在被撒落在——
First Wicker's Spark#087.speaker: Azael

First Wicker's Spark#088.src: Didn't take you as one to wax poetic. So what do you propose? Betray Her Majesty? What choice do WE have?
First Wicker's Spark#088.dst: 沒想到你還會詩興大發。那你提議怎樣？背叛陛下？「我們」有什麼選擇？
First Wicker's Spark#088.speaker: Gikyo

First Wicker's Spark#089.src: You can't possibly be that misguided! This isn't just Ophir's tragedy - all of us will be punished! Her Majesty won't stop at just a simple reprimand!
First Wicker's Spark#089.dst: 你不可能糊塗到這種地步！這不只是 Ophir 的悲劇——我們全都會受罰！陛下可不會訓斥一頓就算了！
First Wicker's Spark#089.speaker: Gikyo

First Wicker's Spark#090.src: ... I'll be going. Haha! Feel free to drop by, if you ever fix that way of thinking!
First Wicker's Spark#090.dst: ……我走了。哈哈！哪天你把那套想法改掉了，歡迎來坐坐！
First Wicker's Spark#090.speaker: Gikyo

First Wicker's Spark#091.src: ... betray...? Betray Her Majesty, you say...?
First Wicker's Spark#091.speaker: Azael
